fee_notes: FLEX Program $12,500; GROW Program $10,000; +JPAR Program $12,500. 15% discount available for veterans, existing franchisees adding a location, or referrals. Rapid Expansion Program allows eligible existing franchisees to open in new market with no initial franchise fee.
raw_excerpt: Individual Franchisees pay an initial franchise fee ranging from $10,000 to $12,500 per Location, depending on the franchise program selected
